description: The MLSO K-Cor catalogue records automatically detected coronal mass ejections from near-real-time coronagraph images. It includes detection alerts and estimated event properties such as position and speed. The resource is documented by NCAR; NASA GSFC. The documented physical domain is Solar; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Continuous/RT Run (ISWA data tree), Continuous/RT Run (SEP Scoreboard Intensity), Continuous/RT Run (SEP Scoreboard Probability). A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. Automatic detections can be false, and changing signal quality affects event identification. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
